scope: Source inventory, not a claim that all states are captured

screens.title: City map with place shelf
entry_steps: Select Jubilee Hills / Kokapet / All Hyderabad
Map view; wait for real tiles and populated pins
screens.capture_notes: Explore remains Mapbox. Do not use this image as evidence of a Google Explore migration.

screens.title: Place board and filtered catalogue
entry_steps: Enter real venue/category query or select a category
screens.capture_notes: Preserve search, category and area on Back. Category controls use actual CityCategory raw values.

screens.title: Area menu and search keyboard
entry_steps: Tap area menu or focus search
screens.capture_notes: Menu label is All Hyderabad; generated provider queries normalize it to Hyderabad.

screens.title: Place detail with sourced media and actions
entry_steps: Open a source-backed catalogue place from board, map shelf, Ask or Saved
screens.capture_notes: Current editorial entry is pushed; older tests that expect place.close may need navigation-selector updates. No invented photos.

screens.title: Google place location preview
screens.capture_notes: Preview has approximate independent coordinates, no GPS request or automatic guidance. The Google attribution must remain visible.

screens.title: Place facts, source links and photo credits
screens.capture_notes: Source URLs/credit text are real UI. They do not establish current hours or entrance verification.

screens.title: Published arrival guide
entry_steps: Open a place with a valid published arrival manifest
screens.capture_notes: Conditional source-backed screen. No dedicated UITest selector/flow found. Do not create a fake verified entrance merely to capture it.

screens.title: Intent-led first screen and category grid
entry_steps: Start a new conversation if needed
screens.capture_notes: Actual local source-backed picks depend on area/taste; no authentication needed to browse.

screens.title: Searchable category browser
entry_steps: Search Chemists or another registry category
screens.capture_notes: Use current source registry, not a hardcoded marketing category count.

screens.title: Guided directory results and automatic filter
entry_steps: Choose All Hyderabad / Jubilee Hills / Kokapet
Filter a real place name; dismiss keyboard
screens.capture_notes: Local directory browsing does not itself send an AI request.

screens.title: Honest empty service category with Google handoff
entry_steps: Choose Loans (or another genuinely empty current category)
Show places and verify actual count 0
screens.capture_notes: No invented providers, booking or loan offers. Google search is a separate provider surface.

screens.title: Request details and exact place selection
entry_steps: Or enter from explicit Saved selection
screens.capture_notes: Do not broaden selected IDs while preparing screenshots; no Send is needed for this screen.

screens.title: Editable outing templates
screens.capture_notes: Template action prepares a draft and must not claim an AI result.

screens.title: Activities and preferences editor
entry_steps: Choose 2–4 activities, areas, company, budget and total duration
screens.capture_notes: Budget and company are preferences, not booking or pricing guarantees.

screens.title: Explicit optional start time in IST
screens.capture_notes: IST preference only; no verification of venue hours or future traffic.

screens.title: Desired stay durations per activity
entry_steps: Choose desired stay for each stage
screens.capture_notes: Visit minutes are chosen by the user, not inferred venue facts.

screens.title: Editable type-or-voice composer
entry_steps: Enter a user-authored request without sending
screens.capture_notes: Keep personal messages out of publicly distributed screenshots.

screens.title: Voice recording, processing and retry
entry_steps: Grant actual microphone permission if chosen
screens.capture_notes: No dedicated voice UITest found. Do not fabricate transcript or claim a simulator recording proves physical-iPhone audio.

screens.title: Live generation progress and streaming text
entry_steps: Explicitly Send with intended QA account
screens.capture_notes: Transient capture timing not guaranteed by current snapshot calls. Cancel changes visible state; no fake progress fixture.

screens.title: Source-bound AI answer and generative layout
screens.capture_notes: Exact layout and venues depend on actual reply. Only capture completed content as a final answer.

screens.title: Compare current shortlist and create a draft
screens.capture_notes: This is the current in-session shortlist; do not portray account-backed named shortlist browsing unless present in UI.

screens.title: Staged AI outing with checks and save
screens.capture_notes: Do not label this a booked itinerary. Save reveals the exact stable plan in Plans.

screens.title: Keep/replace one stop while refining a saved plan
entry_steps: Plans → eligible 2–4-stop plan → Refine with Ask
Choose a stage to replace; retain other pins
screens.capture_notes: Preserve plan ID, selected pins and preference metadata; test writes should remain QA-local.

screens.title: Confirmed saved-link idea with explicit note consent
entry_steps: Choose Explore this idea / plan around it
Leave note excluded unless explicitly opted in
screens.capture_notes: Original URL/caption is local metadata; no automatic scraping or AI submission.

screens.title: Earlier conversation and retained answer after failure
entry_steps: Expand earlier messages, or inspect authentic interrupted/failed follow-up state
screens.capture_notes: Current source contains recovery UI, but no dedicated current UI test was found for every branch. Do not present retained answer as the failed request’s reply.

screens.title: Saved places collection
screens.capture_notes: Local saves can sync only when explicitly enabled. Empty capture must use an already empty QA profile, not erase someone’s collection.

screens.title: Explicit ordered up-to-eight-place selection
entry_steps: Saved → Plan with Ask or create draft
Tap eligible leisure places in desired order
screens.capture_notes: Selection excludes care/services for outings; Ask handoff does not auto-send.

screens.title: Reels & links inbox
screens.capture_notes: Plain saved source links and user notes, not scraped videos or generated captions.

screens.title: Add a public link and personal note
entry_steps: Paste valid public URL and optional user-authored note
screens.capture_notes: Use benign public URL; do not expose token-bearing links or private notes.

screens.title: Review source and explicitly attach catalogue place
screens.capture_notes: An unconfirmed Reel is not a place. Preserve explicit identity confirmation.

screens.title: Confirmed idea: ask, add next activity or link plan
entry_steps: Select next leisure activity / Ask / create local draft
screens.capture_notes: No automatic messaging and no silent note transmission.

screens.title: Draft plans list and exact saved-plan reveal
entry_steps: Or save/refine a plan from Ask to reveal its stable UUID
screens.capture_notes: Ordinary tab return must not replay the reveal. No trip starts when revealing a plan.

screens.title: Expanded plan, brief and ordered stops
entry_steps: Expand a real local QA draft
screens.capture_notes: Requested activities/time are preferences; creation date is not a booking date.

screens.title: Rename, reorder and remove draft stops
screens.capture_notes: Do not modify existing personal plans for screenshot decoration.

screens.title: Travel-between-stops estimates
entry_steps: Expanded plan → Check travel between stops
screens.capture_notes: Travel estimates remain Mapbox between selected stops. No user-location permission needed for this check.

screens.title: Visits plus travel budget and projected timeline
entry_steps: Ask draft → time budget or saved plan → travel
screens.capture_notes: No fit/finish claim unless all required durations and legs known; timeline is projected, not verified venue access.

screens.title: Edit visit times without replacing route
screens.capture_notes: Known current route can be reused for duration-only edits; stale identity cannot.

screens.title: Manual next-stop progress
entry_steps: Mark visited / skip only by user action
screens.capture_notes: Directions never mark arrival. Use local QA records for manual progress.

screens.title: Explicit stay timer and return continuity
screens.capture_notes: Timer does not automatically mark a stop visited.

screens.title: Completed checklist, undo and restart
entry_steps: Explicitly mark/skip every stop in QA outing
screens.capture_notes: Progress is manual, not GPS attendance verification.

screens.title: Connection and collection sync controls
screens.capture_notes: Capture controls without enabling sync or replacing copies solely for a screenshot. Existing sync test requires explicit KULTURE_ENABLE_EXISTING_SYNC gate.

screens.title: Sign-in form and keyboard
screens.capture_notes: Capture an empty form; never expose private email/password. Password stays secure but email is visible.

screens.title: Create-account and recovery affordances
entry_steps: Sign-in → Create a new account toggle
Or inspect Forgot password / email availability
screens.capture_notes: Do not actually create accounts or trigger recovery email solely to capture the screen.

screens.title: Signed-in account and privacy details
screens.capture_notes: Email is visible; use approved public demo identity or keep this capture private.

screens.title: Interests, pace, nightlife and Live Activity preferences
screens.capture_notes: Preference buttons currently use visible labels rather than individual stable IDs. No measured travel-time claim from pace.

screens.title: Explicit like / hide / undo on place
entry_steps: Scroll controls above sticky Directions dock
Choose only preflight-approved QA feedback fixture
screens.capture_notes: These mutate persistent account feedback, not Saved. Never reuse a personal fixture without checking its prior choice.

screens.title: Liked / hidden place history
screens.capture_notes: Account-scoped. Sign-out must clear private rows.

screens.title: Sourced contact facts and visit checklist
entry_steps: Ask cafes → All Hyderabad → Concu → Contact
screens.capture_notes: Published facts are not a live call/opening check. Do not tap Call/Website just to capture.

screens.title: Central contact and honest missing contact facts
entry_steps: Ask hospitals → Medicover Financial District for central contact
UniCare Global Hospitals Kokapet for unknown cohort fields
screens.capture_notes: Fixture content can change; check current API facts. No emergency/clinical claims.

screens.title: Editable enquiry copied for the user to send
screens.capture_notes: Copy only; no message is sent and no booking is made.

screens.title: Explicit Google search and provider result cards
entry_steps: Initial query Chemists in Hyderabad auto-submits once
screens.capture_notes: Require loaded N with N>0 AND real SDK row. Placeholder rows during loading are not result evidence. Tap place name, not reviews/external-arrow controls.

screens.title: Actual Google Place details
entry_steps: Tap name of actual Google result
screens.capture_notes: Google content stays provider-owned/ephemeral. Keep required Google attribution and contributor credits.

screens.title: Directions-intent branch selection
entry_steps: Directions from a real listing with no sourced coordinate
Select exact provider branch → native route preview
screens.capture_notes: Directions intent skips detail after branch selection; ordinary Google browsing retains detail. Do not fabricate coordinate matches.

screens.title: Native in-app route preview
entry_steps: Place Directions or Google detail Navigate
Explicit Directions entry auto-checks route once
screens.capture_notes: Only current real SDK route-ready state is evidence. Start guidance remains explicit.

screens.title: Active Google turn-by-turn guidance
screens.capture_notes: Existing automated flow uses SDK simulation, not physical travel. Real-world guidance requires device field testing.

screens.title: Clearly labelled SDK simulated guidance
entry_steps: QA simulator route ready → Simulate route
screens.capture_notes: Keep SIMULATED ROUTE label in image. Never remove it or describe it as a real trip.

screens.title: Provider information and licenses
screens.capture_notes: Back from licenses must not auto-restart route/guidance. No dedicated screenshot function found.

screens.title: Unknown-position or map unavailable fallback
entry_steps: Open independently sourced real listing without coordinate
screens.capture_notes: Unknown real place offers branch lookup; demo/imported OSM action is blocked. Do not deliberately break production configuration.

screens.title: Native iPhone share extension
entry_steps: Safari → share a benign public page
screens.capture_notes: Host share sheet is iOS UI; screenshot is from Safari/extension. No private social-account scraping.

screens.title: Review outing before publishing unlisted link
entry_steps: Review exact stops and excluded private data
screens.capture_notes: Publishing is explicit. Link excludes notes, brief, chosen start, taste, location history and owner identity.

screens.title: Created share link and system share sheet
screens.capture_notes: An unlisted URL grants access; use intended public demo link or keep artifact private. Do not expose unrelated capabilities.

screens.title: Open shared plan and save independent copy
entry_steps: Plans → Open a shared plan or valid deep link
screens.capture_notes: Snapshot order/title immutable; current place facts can update or become unavailable.

screens.title: Owned share links and revoke confirmation
screens.capture_notes: Revoke only link created by the QA flow. Existing links must be preserved.

screens.title: Expired or revoked shared plan
entry_steps: Open own QA-created link after intentional revoke
screens.capture_notes: No fabricated provider replacement for a withdrawn stop.

screens.title: Navigation Dynamic Island / Lock Screen
screens.capture_notes: Use XCUIScreen capture, not app.screenshot. Expanded Google route values include Google Maps attribution; simulation label must stay.

screens.title: Stay countdown Dynamic Island / Lock Screen
entry_steps: Begin QA-local outing → explicitly start stay timer
screens.capture_notes: Countdown is user-selected stay duration, not venue availability.

screens.title: Manual next-stop Live Activity
screens.capture_notes: Source exists; no dedicated current Island snapshot function found for outing alone.

screens.title: Transient Ask and voice Live Activities
entry_steps: Explicit Send or start actual microphone recording
Capture active system surface while app remains valid
screens.capture_notes: Prompt/transcript hidden. These transient activities end on background; do not stage a false long-running background state.

screens.title: Actual Dynamic Type accessibility layout
entry_steps: Set actual simulator/device content size accessibility-medium
Open Explore and Ask with keyboard
Restore previous content size after capture
screens.capture_notes: Legacy launch flag alone is not proof of Dynamic Type.

screens.title: Reduced motion / transparency settings
entry_steps: Use actual accessibility Reduce Motion / Reduce Transparency setting
Capture main tab and pushed detail
screens.capture_notes: No dedicated acceptance flow found. Screenshot cannot prove animation smoothness; use a recording for motion.

screens.title: Authentic provider, contact and AI failure states
entry_steps: Only capture naturally occurring failure or isolated authorized QA failure condition
Keep code/status text visible and sanitized
screens.capture_notes: Do not simulate success. Do not alter production keys, account data or live backend solely to force errors.

screens.title: Empty Saved, Plans, inbox and choices
entry_steps: Use an already empty dedicated QA profile/account
screens.capture_notes: No destructive reset or personal collection deletion to obtain empty screenshots.

screens.title: Native consent, location and microphone prompts
entry_steps: Trigger only the explicitly requested feature in a fresh permission state
screens.capture_notes: System-controlled prompts vary by iOS and prior permission state; absence is not an app defect.
